interpretation: An old generation string embedded in an image is not proof that the active bootstrap executes that generation.
The software catalogue uses512K; that is not sufficient evidence of historical RP hardware semantics.
A recollection of128pages does not specify the bit layout or memory bank wiring required by an implementation.
No guest state or boot parameters were altered to force operating-system readiness during this audit.
Memory expansion requires an explicit configuration choice and independently specified control vectors.
